subject: Confirming invoice window & PO timing for Feb bookings recognition
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming invoice window & PO timing for Feb bookings recognition

Hi Jamal / Acme procurement team,

Quick note as we close the month: we need to lock the invoice window that will allow us to recognize the bookings tied to the Feb deployment ramp. To make the numbers match up for month-end recognition the PO needs to be issued and the invoice window confirmed by the end of next week.

I attached a short spreadsheet (invoice_slots.xlsx) with the two acceptable invoice windows we discussed and how each maps to Redwood's revenue milestones. Can you confirm which window Acme will use and the expected PO send date? If you can provide the PO number when it's issued, our billing ops (cc'd) will queue the invoice to hit the correct recognition period.

Key asks: 
- Confirm invoice window (Option A: invoice issued by 2028-02-24 to recognize in Feb; Option B: invoice issued 2028-02-28–03-03 to push recognition to Mar)
- Confirm expected PO issue date and whether it will include the standard payment terms (Net 30)

Ben / Rishi — FYI, once Jamal confirms we'll route the invoice and lock the revenue recognition mapping. If there's any dependency on the delivery acceptance milestone we should note that here.

Thanks,

— Lauren Bishop
Sr. Finance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0173
From: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirming invoice window & PO timing for Feb bookings recognition

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear note. We're targeting Option A to keep this in Feb if Redwood can accept an invoice dated 2028-02-24. Procurement is prioritizing this PO and I expect they’ll issue it this Friday, 2028-02-17, with a PO number returned the same day. I will confirm formally once Procurement posts it.

Two quick clarifications: 
1) The acceptance milestone referenced in the SOW is internal testing signoff — Acme will sign that today, so there are no expected hold-ups.
2) Our PO will include standard Net 30 terms; if Redwood needs Net 45 or different language we should discuss now (not anticipated).

I’ll loop back Friday with the PO PDF attached (procurement has committed).

Best,
Jamal Reed
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation
jamal.reed@acme.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirming invoice window & PO timing for Feb bookings recognition

Lauren — thanks for driving this.

I reviewed the invoice_slots.xlsx and confirmed our billing ops can target the 2028-02-24 invoice date (Option A). A couple of internal notes: 
- Once we receive the PO we need the exact billing contact and billing address as it appears on the PO to avoid re-issuance delays.
- If Acme marks the PO as "non-negotiable" please let us know so Legal can avoid any last-minute redlines that would push recognition.

I'll prepare the invoice draft and hold until we get the PO file (PDF). Rishi, can you confirm with bookings whether any delivery acceptance signoff or ticket close is still pending?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@acme.com <procurement@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: PO issued: ACME_PO_9876.pdf attached 

Attached please find PO ACME_PO_9876.pdf.

Summary: 
- PO Number: ACME_PO_9876
- Issue date: 2028-02-17 (procurement system shows timestamp)
- Billing contact: Accounts Payable, Acme Corporation, ap@acme.com
- Payment terms: Net 30

We have marked the PO to allow invoice issuance with invoice date 2028-02-24 so Redwood can recognize the bookings in Feb. Please confirm receipt of the PO and inform us of the invoice number when created.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement Team
(attachment: ACME_PO_9876.pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@acme.com, Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO issued: ACME_PO_9876.pdf attached

Received — thanks for the fast turnaround and for aligning the invoice date. 

Next steps on our side: 
- Ben / Billing Ops will create invoice INV-20280224-ACME and issue it dated 2028-02-24 (to ap@acme.com).
- We will map the booking to Feb recognition per the schedule in invoice_slots.xlsx; Marissa (CC) will update the revenue forecast and ensure the numbers flow into the Feb close pack.
- I’ll post the HubSpot deal note with PO number and attach the PO PDF (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3509/ACME-2028-07).

Please confirm once the invoice is received by Acme AP so we can close the loop. If anything changes on your side that would move the invoice date, let us know immediately — otherwise we’ll proceed for Feb recognition.

Appreciate the quick cooperation.

— Lauren
Sr. Finance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: invoice_slots.xlsx)
